hypotheses.A1_weight_jacobian_explains_native_trans: The same chain predicts complete native coordinate responses with energy fidelity at least 0.95 on every corpus.
hypotheses.A2_weight_jacobian_predicts_graph_change: It predicts finite selected-edge changes in the attention-frozen world with energy fidelity at least 0.99 on every corpus.
hypotheses.A3_fixed_late_subspace_is_sufficient: Projecting the tangent back into the fixed late 32-dimensional subspace after every MLP retains at least 0.80 fidelity to the full MLP-path response on every corpus.
hypotheses.A4_off_subspace_routes_are_material: Full-space analytic fidelity exceeds repeatedly projected fidelity by at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.A5_weight_derived_account_transfers_ood: OOD native-response fidelity is within 0.03 of FineWeb.
